about_the_game: Ninja Blast is an interactive ninja experience with action, adventure and strategy elements, tells the story of two ninjas who emerge on a battlefield between the ninjas and the tyrannical empire of Fireon, seeing their country taken over and devastated by the empire, these two ninjas unite for bloody revenge.
